headline.title: We searched "physical therapy San Marcos CA". Balanced Beast appeared in none of the 18 results, even though some of them were clinics in San Marcos, Texas.
headline.detail: Hospital groups, Luna (home PT), Select Physical Therapy and directory pages filled the list. People searching for a PT in your city were shown clinics in another state before you.

summary: Balanced Beast has 99 five-star reviews, and patients who tried other clinics say the difference is seeing the same Doctor of PT every visit. But in our search you didn't appear, and a nearby clinic with 134 five-star reviews stays open until 7pm.

you.notes: One-on-one DPT; Wednesday to noon; closed weekends

competitors.name: Longevity Physical Therapy – San Marcos
competitors.notes: E San Marcos Blvd; open to 7pm

competitors.name: Spine & Sport Physical Therapy – San Marcos

search.result: Results included CHRISTUS Health and texpts.com (San Marcos, Texas), Luna, Select Physical Therapy and Scripps directory pages. Balanced Beast was not among the 18 results.
search.meaning: Even a search for your own city doesn't lead to you, so new patients rarely hear about the one-on-one care your reviews describe.

visibility: In our search for physical therapy in San Marcos, you did not appear. Directories, hospital groups and even clinics in San Marcos, Texas took the results.
lead: 99 reviews, all five stars, many from people let down by other clinics.
The same Doctor of PT every visit: a clear, powerful difference.
A complimentary first visit, and a welcoming clinic (with Nikko the dog).
lose: A nearby clinic with 134 five-star reviews is open until 7pm; you close at noon on Wednesdays.
Patients comparing clinics can't see that you offer a complimentary first visit.
Your 'same doctor every time' promise is buried in reviews.

gaps.title: Frustrated patients can't find you
gaps.detail: Your best patients come from clinics where they saw a different assistant every time. People searching for a better option right now don't find you.

gaps.title: Your free first visit is invisible
gaps.detail: Reviews mention it, but someone deciding between clinics never sees it.

gaps.title: Discharged patients drift away
gaps.detail: Without check-ins after discharge, patients don't come back when the next injury happens.

actions.title: Lead with 'same Doctor of PT, every visit'
actions.why: It's the reason patients switch to you; put it front and center.

actions.title: Show the complimentary first visit clearly
actions.why: It removes the risk for hesitant patients comparing clinics.

actions.title: Reply to recent reviews and ask happy patients for more
actions.why: Doable today: replies show you care, and new reviews keep you ahead of nearby clinics.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your approach, team and complimentary first visit, with one-tap booking.

plan.title: Review requests
plan.detail: Automatic messages after each plan of care, so happy patients become reviews.

plan.title: Check-ins after discharge
plan.detail: Messages that bring patients back before small aches become injuries.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Bookings and how you compare with San Marcos clinics.

scenario: A runner in San Marcos has seen a different assistant every visit at her current PT and still has knee pain. She searches "physical therapy San Marcos CA" on her lunch break, sees a hospital group and a home-PT service, and books whichever has a slot. She never finds the clinic where she'd see the same doctor every time. (Illustration.)
nochange: Patients who would love your approach keep landing at the clinics you're the antidote to. Your reviews grow slowly, while groups with bigger budgets keep the search results.
